repositories.name: CyberNova
repositories.description: A Cyber defense system that autonomously detects, analyzes and mitigate cyber threats in Realtime. Partly acts as SIEM with alert dashboards and LLM based analytics with domain specific fine model fine tuned by Q-Lora.

repositories.name: Plagiarism-Detection-System
repositories.description: A Java-based plagiarism detection tool with a user-friendly Swing GUI. Compares two files using cosine similarity to calculate similarity percentage and detect plagiarism. Features intuitive file selection, real-time results, and aesthetic design. Easily extensible for more file formats and detailed reports.

repositories.name: Portfolio-Website
repositories.description: This website showcases my journey, skills, and projects as a web developer. Built using HTML and CSS, it highlights my dedication to crafting responsive, visually appealing, and well-structured web solutions. It also reflects my passion for continuous learning and innovation, demonstrating my commitment to growth and excellence in web development.

repositories.name: Prometheus-Based-System-Performance-Monitoring-and-Alerting-System
repositories.description: Prometheus-based system performance monitoring and alerting solution deployed on AWS EC2. It collects CPU metrics using Node Exporter, evaluates them with Prometheus, and sends real-time email alerts via Alertmanager when performance degrades, ensuring proactive monitoring and reliability.

repositories.name: tracknova
repositories.description: TrackNova is a collaborative project and task management platform for teams. Create projects, assign tasks, manage invites, and control access with roles. Google Sign-In simplifies onboarding. Dashboards and real-time updates keep work organized, accelerate delivery, and maintain visibility across projects.
